landmarks.evidence: Layout read against the OSM outline (way 952914329): the photos from the garden (south) show, west to east, a two-storey pedimented wing with an oculus and the entrance (OSM: the 13 m west-end projection), a two-storey link with six window axes (21 m), the tall main block whose south risalit carries a pediment over three window axes (OSM risalit: 16 m south face, 24 m west face with six arched axes) and the domed tower on its south-EAST corner, then a two-storey pedimented east wing (9.3 m). 3.4 correction: the tower stands on the risalit's south-east corner, not the south-west one (3.0) - every view from the south and south-west shows the three-axis pediment face to the LEFT of the tower and the six-axis face receding further left, and only a sliver plus the east wing to its right. Main block: two storeys (as OSM building:levels=2) - rectangular ground-floor windows, a tall upper storey whose windows are rectangles with a separate arched fanlight, broken-tile mosaic panels above them, lighter tile pilasters between the bays; whole complex clad in small ceramic tiles (pink/beige patchwork on the main block, orange-pink on the wings), grey stone plinth, pink cornice bands, light-grey sheet-metal roofs. West wing: blue and yellow painted band above the plinth, door right of centre. Estimates (scale from door and window heights): eaves 12.3 m (main), 10 m (end wings), 8.8 m (link); pediment rises 2-2.6 m. Not modelled: the street (north) facade with its four-column portico (position along the facade not determinable from the photos), door canopies, mosaic motifs (drawn as generic speckle), plaques.

landmarks.evidence: Two storeys, salmon/peach plaster with white trim and arched windows, brown metal-tile hipped roof with gabled dormers (dormers not modelled).
landmarks.identity_audit: 2026-11-14: NOT confirmed. For the ML candidate ms:aa972e1721d8: it fronts пров. Каштановий (address 8(10), official oblast inventory 2017 'просп. Володарського, 8'), a 2019 Commons photo was taken from the lane 17 m away. Against: its lane front is ~35 m with 5-8 m projections, while the photos show a straight front of ~14-16 window axes (~45 m) with shallow risalits; the WLM/Wikidata point lies across the lane in a block that ESA WorldCover classes as built-up, has no tree canopy and no footprint in any source - the real building may be unmapped there. The photo geometry fits both sides. Missing: a mapped outline on the NW side, or a photo with camera bearing / an identifiable landmark of the other side. Not reconstructed.

landmarks.evidence: Identity: Commons category 'Synagogue in Skvyra' is the Wikidata item's P373; a 2025 photo geotag falls inside the OSM footprint; 2007-2025 photos by six authors show the same building (painted pink in 2008, red brick after the renovation of ~2018-2019). Observed: three blocks along a 51 m south front - west block with a south-facing gable and a Star-of-David gable window (2 storeys over a rubble-stone semi-basement; it is the 5.6 m projection of the OSM outline), central two-storey block with a stepped brick attic over the entrance, eastern prayer hall with a door and 8 tall round-arched windows; red brick, grey rubble-stone plinth, dark metal roofs, brick corbel frieze under the eaves, two stone stairs along the facade. Estimated (from frontal photos, scale from door heights): block lengths 9 / 18 / 24 m, eaves 5.9 / 5.6 / 4.5 m, roof rises, attic size, stair and door positions. Not visible / assumed: rear and roof plan behind the front, exact window counts on the north side.

landmarks.evidence: Street front (2014 and 2017 photos): one tall storey of whitewashed brick (lime wash peeling on the left, the right two bays painted white), six windows with plastered surrounds in a 17.5 m front - this matches the south-east edge of the Microsoft ML outline (17.5 m, six 2.9 m bays) facing вул. Київська; central curved (ogee) brick attic with a small arched niche, its outline in exposed red brick, over windows 3-4; a band of dentils and rosettes under the eaves; low hipped roof of grey asbestos-cement slate; a later porch annex and a two-storey neighbour with a green roof adjoin on the left (not part of this outline). Estimates (scale from the 2.9 m bays): eave ~4.6 m, windows ~2.3 m tall, attic ~4.9 m wide, rises ~1.7 m above the eave. Not visible / not modelled: side and rear facades (drawn with the same windows), chimney ornament, the street fence.

landmarks.name: Адміністративна будівля на центральній площі (за пам'ятником Т. Шевченку)
landmarks.evidence: Identity: the OSM outline (way 953018275, 42.9 x 12.8 m, building=yes, no name or use tag) is the only large building on the square; its long north-east face is 23 m from the OSM node 'Тарас Шевченко', and the monument stands on the axis of that face in the 2008 photo. Observed (Orest Brod 2008-09-15, frontal, north-east face): Soviet-era office block with a flat roof and a railing; three storeys of wide windows (white frames, three panes) between light tile-clad pilasters, brick-red spandrel panels between the window rows, a plain tiled band and a narrow green band with small vents under the roof edge; a flat white entrance canopy over the ground floor on the axis (its right half is hidden by the statue - assumed symmetric). Current state: the 2021 aerial photos (Велике будівництво, CC BY 4.0) show the same light flat-roofed block of four window rows beyond the south-east end of the stadium. Estimates (scale from the storeys; a frontal photo from about 1.6 m): storey 3.5 m, top bands 2.6 m, roof edge 13.6 m, window bays 3.0 m (12 bays on the square side) and a blank tile-clad stair bay of about 6.8 m at the north-west end (2008 photo: window pitch 132 px, blank end 300 px, facade 42.9 m), canopy 13 x 3 m at 4 m. Use: not stated in the sources (shown as an office/public building). Not modelled: the small vents of the green band, the roof railing and antennas, rear and end facades (drawn like the front).

landmarks.name: Будинок культури (у ньому за OSM — Сквирський народний краєзнавчий музей), вул. Богачевського, 35
landmarks.evidence: Identity: OSM way 1573335660 (41.3 x 23.4 m) carries addr Богачевського 35 and tourism=museum; the WLM list places the Afghan war memorial at 'вул. Богачевського, 35 (біля Будинку культури)'. Position: a 2019 360-degree panorama taken beside that memorial (phone GPS +-10-30 m; azimuths fixed by the low November sun) - the bearings of the pediment, of the block's corners and of the far end of the hall fit this outline to within 1 degree when the camera stands 12 m north of its GPS point. Observed (WestBam 2019-11-22): at the north-east end a two-storey block in salmon-orange plaster with a white cornice, a pediment with a round window over a front of three window axes facing south-east, white plastic windows with brick-pattern surrounds; along the rest of the south-east side a one-storey hall in darker terracotta plaster with a row of windows, a low hipped slate roof and a raised upper roof; grey asbestos-cement and sheet roofs. Estimates: block 10.3 m along the street side (from its angular width at the solved distance), eaves 8.6 m (block) and 4.5 m (hall), pediment rise 3.2 m; colours from the dusk panorama scaled so that the white house next to the camera reads white (factors R 1.65, G 1.60, B 1.47). Not visible / not modelled: the north-west and north-east facades, the entrance, the two-tier hall roof (drawn as one hipped roof), the window surrounds.

monuments.name: Пам'ятник Герою Радянського Союзу М. М. Ольшевському
monuments.location_note: Wikidata/WLM coordinate (6 decimals). Consistent with the photos: the large building clad in yellow and blue sheet behind the bust is the lyceum annex (OSM way 952914328) 23 m to the east, so the front faces west; the lyceum's own plaque says Olshevskyi studied there.
monuments.evidence: Black granite pillar with the inscription and a gold star, on a lower black granite block and a two-step base of rough black stone; dark bronze bust in a tank helmet. Scale from the head (~0.4 m): pillar ~0.6 x 2.6 m, block ~0.8 x 1.2 m, steps ~2.4 / 2.0 m, bust ~0.8 m wide, ~0.95 m tall; total ~5.3 m. Depths not visible (assumed square-ish). Sculpture drawn as a simple blocky bust - no likeness.

monuments.name: Пам'ятник Т. Г. Шевченку (центральна площа)
monuments.location_note: Placed on the Microsoft ML outline ms:ea6509eb312e (6.1 x 3.4 m, 20 m2), which the pipeline drew as a 3 m white shed in the middle of the square: it lies on the axis of the administrative building's north-east face, 11.6 m in front of it, exactly where the 2008 photo shows the monument (the OSM node, 11 m further north-east, is a rough point). The ML outline is suppressed as a building (data/overrides/overrides.json) and used as the platform.
monuments.evidence: Orest Brod 2008-09-15 (frontal): standing Shevchenko in a long coat with a cape thrown over the shoulders, spreading further to the statue's right; red-brown (copper-coloured) surface; a red-brown slab under the feet on a wide grey stone pedestal with a dark inscription plate. Figure: the front outline is traced from the photo at 11 heights (coat 0.35-0.38 of the figure height wide, cape 0.53, head 0.15 wide and 0.18 tall, shifted to the statue's left); depth is not visible - assumed about 0.5-0.6 of the width (typical for a standing figure; the cape wraps the shoulders), back mirrored from the front; no facial or portrait features. Absolute size from the storeys of the building behind (+-30 %): figure about 4.5 m, slab 0.43 m, pedestal 2.0 m (its lower part is hidden by people). The 2008 photo is the latest one found; the OSM node and the ML outline confirm that the monument stands there.
